{{Quote|Governor, one of our probes seems to have found something. We believe these are the speeder bikes responsible for the rebel activity near Jalath.|Agent Kallus, to Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin|<ref name="CTA" />}}
'''Jalath''' was a [[city]] located on the [[planet]] of [[Lothal]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] region of [[the galaxy]]. Following its occupation of Lothal, the [[Galactic Empire]] established a small installation near Jalath.<ref name="CTA" /> Four [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' began approximately five years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], in which the Battle of Yavin takes place. The events of the episodes "[[Empire Day (episode)|Empire Day]]" and "[[Gathering Forces]]" established that the Galactic Empire was celebrating its fifteenth anniversary. Knowing that ''A New Hope'' takes place nineteen years into the Empire's reign, and that "[[Call to Action]]" takes place sometime soon after that anniversary, we can deduce that this event took place roughly four years before the Battle of Yavin.</ref> the [[Spectres|rebel crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]'' [[Raid near Jalath|raided]] that Imperial installation.<ref name="CTA" /> Jalath also hosted the [[Lothal Depot]], which the Spectres [[Mission on Lothal|raided]] a year later in order to "steal" three [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] was covertly delivering to the rebels of [[Phoenix Cell]].<ref name="A Princess on Lothal">{{Rebels|A Princess on Lothal}}</ref>
